preservation: Existing helpers select finite defaults; explicit configured variants retain native ownership.
DICT MAX_LINE and Kepler URI1024 ceilings remain protocol-owned.
Kepler/Text default header wire budgets1025/4097 preserve prior complete-header acceptance boundaries.
FSP attempts3 and one-second RESEND_AFTER retain per-reply timing; sequence/key behavior unchanged.
Native metadata, statuses, dot unstuffing, MIME, timestamps, language and cache representations retained.
FSP dependency-free bounded directory parser preserves old parser API and exposes END separately from SKIP.
No Errand routes, product adapters, consumer repins or snapshot format changes.
review_fixes: Preserve Text old complete-header ceiling as4097 wirebytes, matching Kepler1025 convention.
Reject CR/LF injection in constructed requests before connection/write.
Refuse Kepler empty raw request under zero request budget.
Kepler request parser applies URI ceiling to URI field rather than cache/language fields.
Exercise DICT configured TCP constructor in addition to supplied carriers.
